summary: Follow-up frontend-only verification pass for BeezTrace/Koster Keunen MIS, focused on the 5 confirmed bugs + stuck ContractDetail issue from iteration_4, plus additional untested Part-1 scenarios. VERIFIED FIXED: (1) Sidebar single-actor lockout (my-actor-static-label for Member/FO, my-actor-switcher with working dropdown for Admin), (2) Disabled-actor lockout across Beekeepers/Actors/Contracts/Transactions(Received,Send)/Processing/Company-Profile/Team-member-menu buttons all disabled as Wend Miel, all 4 direct-URL readonly blocks (contract-wizard, receive-form, process-form render correctly; send-form-readonly-block only renders at /transactions/send/new, NOT /send/new which redirects home), buttons re-enable on switch back to Active actor, (3) ContractWizard Supplier correctly disabled/placeholder pre-Standard and enabled+filtered+self-excluded post-Standard, (4) Orphan beekeeper KKWA-TG-00001 no longer appears for any of the 3 admin actor contexts, (5) Member now sees the same 2 contracts as Admin on /contracts. STILL BROKEN: (6) ContractDetail page - clicking a contract row from the list still fails to load: either hangs on 'Loading...' indefinitely (retrying the same contracts?contract_code=eq.X REST call repeatedly) or falsely renders 'No contracts found' for a contract that IS in the list — this is a genuine regression/unresolved issue, not just a fixed slow-load. Additionally verified: Stocks Loss list renders correctly (empty state, no errors); Team invite double-click race is handled correctly (button flips to disabled 'Saving...' after first click, second click is a no-op). Found a NEW bug: Bulk upload invalid (.txt) file rejection throws an uncaught JS exception producing React's dev error overlay/redbox instead of a graceful inline error message. Transaction Approve/Reject full lifecycle and Contract Update modal validation were attempted but not completed due to complex multi-step searchable-combobox form interactions (village/beekeeper Command-style selects) consuming test time; not confirmed as bugs, flagged as still-untested.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a contract row from /contracts list navigates to /contracts/:code but detail content either hangs on 'Loading...' (network tab shows the same contracts?contract_code=eq.X REST call fired 3x) or resolves to 'No contracts found' for a contract that is visibly present in the list (e.g. NQQ76O0IP4 and 0LJS1WIODY both reproduced this as Chinedu Okafor AND as Amina Yusuf actor context). This is the same core issue flagged in iteration_4 (previously described as slow-Loading) and is STILL UNRESOLVED, now manifesting as either infinite loading or a false not-found. Likely RLS/query mismatch between the list source (contract_groups table, join to actors) and the detail fetch (contracts table filtered by contract_code) — the detail query may be hitting RLS restrictions or the wrong table/column.

Uploading a non-.xlsx file (e.g. .txt) throws an uncaught JS exception ('Unsupported file type. Please upload an .xlsx file.') that surfaces as React's dev error overlay/redbox rather than being caught and shown as an inline/toast error. The validation logic and message text are correct, but the error is not caught in a try/catch around the file parse call, so the app effectively crashes the page in this state.

Navigating directly to /send/new (without the /transactions prefix) silently redirects to the dashboard '/' instead of showing the send-form-readonly-block or even the normal Send form. The correct working route is /transactions/send/new. Minor routing inconsistency versus the review-request wording, but not a blocker since the canonical route works.

Two column headers render raw i18n keys instead of translated text: 'beekeepersList.totalHives' and 'beekeepersList.activeYears' (seen on /beekeepers for Amina Yusuf and other actors). Missing translation strings.

issues: Uses native browser mm/dd/yyyy date input instead of a shadcn calendar/date-picker component (receive-date and contract signature date fields).

action_items: PRIORITY: Fix ContractDetail page — the detail fetch for an existing, list-visible contract either loops on 'Loading...' or falsely reports 'No contracts found'. Compare the RLS policy / query used by contracts?contract_code=eq.X detail fetch against the contract_groups-based list query; likely a table/column/RLS mismatch causing empty results for rows the list query can see via a join.

Wrap the .xlsx file-type validation in ReceiveStockForm bulk upload in a try/catch (or validate before calling the parser) so 'Unsupported file type' surfaces as a normal inline/toast error instead of an uncaught exception crashing the page in dev mode.
Optional: add a redirect/handling for /send/new -> /transactions/send/new instead of silently bouncing to dashboard.
Add missing i18n translation strings for 'beekeepersList.totalHives' and 'beekeepersList.activeYears'.

Untested this pass (time-constrained): full Received transaction create->Approve->stock-increase and create->Reject-with-reason->stock-restore lifecycle; Contract Update modal per-line qty/price inline validation and Advance 2-decimal formatting; Sharing create->recipient-login->revoke round-trip. Recommend a focused follow-up pass once ContractDetail bug is fixed (Contract Update modal is opened FROM ContractDetail, so it's currently blocked by bug #6).
critical_code_review_comments: All 5 previously-confirmed bugs from iteration_4 (sidebar single-actor switcher, ContractWizard supplier gating, disabled-actor Add-buttons, orphan beekeeper leak, Member contracts scoping) are now genuinely fixed and verified via real UI interaction across all 3 test accounts. ✅

isReadOnly disabling is consistently applied across Beekeepers, Actors, Contracts, Transactions (Received/Send/Processing), Company Profile Edit/Add-team-member/team-member-menu buttons, and all 4 direct-URL new-form routes tested render their respective readonly-block. ✅

The ContractDetail bug reported as 'slow/stuck Loading' in iteration_4 was NOT actually fixed — it has just changed symptom from infinite-Loading to also intermittently showing a false 'No contracts found', which is arguably worse since it looks like a data-integrity issue to an end user rather than a loading state. This must be root-caused at the query/RLS level, not just given a longer timeout.

The 'stuck ContractDetail' issue is NOT fixed — it's now a CRITICAL priority since Contract Update modal validation (an untested Part-1 scenario) is gated behind opening a working ContractDetail page. rca of the issue: ContractDetail bug: the /contracts list is populated via a query against `contract_groups` (joined to actors), while the detail page fetch performs `contracts?select=*,actors(...)&contract_code=eq.X` directly against a `contracts` table. These are likely two different tables/views with different RLS policies or the `contract_code` column lives on `contract_groups` not `contracts`, causing the detail lookup to return 0 rows even though the same contract is visible via the list's join query. The repeated identical REST calls seen in the network trace (3x for the same contract_code) also suggest a possible retry-loop in the data-fetching hook (e.g. useEffect re-running due to an unstable dependency) compounding the false-negative into an infinite-loading symptom before eventually settling to 'No contracts found'.
